name: Clear Coat - int_door_slab
intent: One clear topcoat + sand (only between coats, gated by coat_lt_ctx). Repeats per ctx.clear_coats via scenario.dynamic_coats. Mirrors MOD_TEMPLATE_TRIM_APPLY_CLEAR but with EA_SIDE keeper tasks for door slabs.
doctrine: Clear for int_door_slab. Sand-clear (320-400 grit typical) fires only between coats via coat_lt_ctx:'clear_coats' — last coat is not sanded since it's the final finish. Brush variant gets WB_CLEAR_BRUSH 0.9× time (faster than paint by brush); spray variant gets WB_CLEAR_SPRAY 1.0× (sprayer viscosity-agnostic). 2026-05-12: split from the previous combined sealer+clear module to support per-pass dynamic_coats looping like the trim stain side.
